notes.title: Version 1.11 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where Shapes could fail to appear.
- Fixed an issue where Shapes would move to the Puzzle Handle instead of the Spawner Handle, when misplaced in the Puzzle.

notes.title: The Demo is here! 🥳
notes.content:
[h1]The Demo for Vetrix Worlds is out! 🥳[/h1]

In this Demo, you'll experience one Arcade Mode with its two modifiers (Classic and Special) as well as one Campaign World with 5 stages.
The rest of the features, such as Multiplayer Versus and Co-op, the three other Arcade Modes, and the other Campaign Worlds will be available in the full game.

Enjoy! 💖

notes.title: Vetrix Worlds is coming! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37696026/3c8aa45b1c3f3457530c827faea0b900121c0fdf.png[/img]

[h1]Get ready for the next chapter in the Vetrix series![/h1]

Vagabond is proud to announce Vetrix Worlds, the latest puzzle game in the beloved franchise.

As in the original game, players must match shapes in a three-dimensional space, but with some exciting new twists.

Vetrix Worlds features improved graphics and new gameplay mechanics, including a new campaign mode that will take you around the world, two multiplayer modes (versus and co-op), new block types, new power-ups, a new arcade mode, and more...

Vetrix Worlds will soon be available in Early Access and we can't wait to get your feedback!

Are you ready to take on the challenge of Vetrix Worlds? Get ready to put your puzzle-solving skills to the test!

[b]Wishlist now! [/b]
